page_title: JUV 1-0 LEC | Juventus v Lecce 26/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+5' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
90+5' Filip Kostic (Juventus) receives a rebound and has a go from distance. His shot flies towards the goal, but is blocked at the last moment by a defender.
90+3' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) won't hear the final whistle in today's game as he is sent off following a second caution and must leave the pitch.
90+1' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' A yellow card for a tackle by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce). Antonio Giua doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
89' Filip Kostic (Juventus) commits a rough foul. Antonio Giua stops the game and makes a call.
88' The ball is behind the sideline. Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) takes a throw-in.
86' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a change. Timothy Weah (Juventus) replaces Weston McKennie.
86' It's time for a substitution. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) comes on in place of Nicolo Fagioli.
85' Antonio Giua shows the yellow card to Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) for a heavy challenge.
85' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
84' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
83' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
82' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) replacing Alexis Blin.
82' Antonio Giua interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce).
79' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
78' Substitution. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) has come on for Arkadiusz Milik.
76' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is booked.
73' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Giua has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
72' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Daniele Rugani is replaced by Federico Gatti (Juventus).
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Filip Kostic (Juventus) comes onto the pitch so that Andrea Cambiaso can be given a rest.
70' Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.

70' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Ylber Ramadani will be replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
69' The foul by Hamza Rafia (Lecce) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Antonio Giua.
66' A precise low pass is received by Adrien Rabiot (Juventus), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
63' Substitution. Lorenzo Venuti makes his way off the pitch and Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) comes on as his replacement.
63' Here is a change. Remi Oudin is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Hamza Rafia (Lecce).
63' Substitution. Gabriel Strefezza did his best and is replaced by Nicola Sansone (Lecce).
62' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Juventus.
59' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Antonio Giua signals that the goal stands! The Juventus players celebrate.
58' The Juventus players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
57' 1 - 0 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Adrien Rabiot and Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 1:0.
57' The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
57' Roberto D'Aversa (Lecce) gets a yellow card, off the field.
56' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus). The linesman points to the corner flag, Juventus are going to take it.
55' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Antonio Giua saw the whole situation.
53' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
53' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
51' One of the players from Lecce times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
49' Daniele Rugani (Juventus) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
46' The Lecce players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
42' Antonio Giua couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Bremer (Juventus) and blew his whistle.
42' The ball is out of play and the goal kick will be taken by Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
41' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
40' Antonio Giua blows his whistle. Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) commits a foul after dangerous play.
38' It's a throw-in for Lecce.
37' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Juventus.
35' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
34' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
31' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a chip pass into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone is quickest to intercept the ball.
30' Antonio Giua shows a yellow card to Ylber Ramadani (Lecce), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
29' Lecce are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
27' Good chance! Federico Chiesa (Juventus) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
26' The resulting corner from Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
26' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

25' Weston McKennie (Juventus) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Antonio Giua with no other option than to blow for a foul.
23' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus).

23' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
23' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) collects a pass and has an effort from distance to the left side of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone answers with a superb save to deny him.
21' A cross into the box from Weston McKennie (Juventus) is cleared.
17' Bremer (Juventus) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
17' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
15' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Antonio Giua blows his whistle for a foul.

13' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
13' The ball is out of play. Juventus will take a throw-in.
9' The free kick will be taken by Remi Oudin (Lecce).
5' The Juventus players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

2' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
1' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
Antonio Giua is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
